div.div: Reading path ① TXD enters the logic interface and is level-shifted to 5 V. ② The pre-driver shapes the edge for the output stage. ③ The differential output drives the bus pins. ④ The receiver reads the bus back to RXD. Channel 2 follows the same path. · dashed boxes are off-chip · pre-silicon architecture; values are design targets
